lines: News of a new brand of toothpaste that prevents Spoilage is hitting the streets, whether or not it's credible is yet to be seen.
Outside Verehn's quarantine, we're hearing news of the reconstruction of the Aijinkovan National History Museum, now with new and improved additions from Our Lady Serebryakova.

The newly reconstructed museum will feature accurate information about the defunct Moshchnyy monarchy, detailing their mishandling of internal policy, infrastructure, and the harms of their feudalistic practices.
The Museum, used as a stronghold during the Aijin Civil War, is projected to be fully repaired by next year.
